reason: I might download the free version for the doctor PDF since that's my actual problem, but I don't pay for apps, period. An AI write-up of my own log isn't worth $5 a month when I can just read it myself before my appointment.
objection: Every app says its predictions are honest, and then they're still wrong for my cycles. And I'm not paying a subscription for something I'd cancel after the trial anyway.
would_change_my_mind: If my doctor actually used the Pro write-up and it changed what happened at my appointment, I might pay for a month or two around visits.
